newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nepal cancels Oct kero tender, reissue next week.
newsitem.headline: Nepal cancels Oct kero tender, reissue next week.

text.p: State-owned Nepal Oil Corp (NOC) has cancelled its tender to buy 30,000 tonnes of superior kerosene for October 1-15 delivery and would reissue the tender next week for November cargoes, an NOC source said on Friday.
"The tender was cancelled on technical grounds," the source said. "We will reissue the tender within the next five days to buy two cargoes for November delivery instead."
One cargo is for November 1-10 delivery, while the second is for November 11-20, he said. NOC might also seek a cargo of high-speed diesel for November 11-20 delivery by tender next week, he added.

The cancelled kerosene tender had attracted seven to eight offers with Kuwait i-based International Petroleum Group (IPG) making the best offer at $245 per tonne, on a cost-and-freight (c&f) basis to India's east coast. The tender closed on September 24.
Traders said the jet-kerosene fuel market was under pressure from abundant supplies, but they said NOC could get better offers if it decided to reissue the tender.
